text: Incoherent optical processing systems can directly implement complex-valued matched filters with arbitrary phase, which is why MZI-mesh neural networks are built with incoherent light.
explanation: False on both counts: incoherent systems operate on intensities and are restricted to non-negative impulse responses, so they cannot realize complex/phase filters, and MZI-mesh neural networks in fact require coherent light. Complex matched filters (including phase) need coherent processing.
